sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-018 involving card-not-present fraud on card SC-03018-K948 belonging to customer SC-03018. The investigation identified four unauthorized card-not-present transactions (4012167, 4012168, 4012169, 4012170) totaling $1,686.36 in exposure [EV-bac21570, EV-5c0fde60]. Transaction 4012167 for $517.26 triggered a real-time risk score of 0.88, prompting review [EV-bac21570]. Analysis revealed four online transactions within a 48-hour window, significantly exceeding the card's historical transaction frequency and average amount of $421.59 [EV-08562653, EV-5c0fde60]. The customer reported no authorization of these transactions and confirmed physical possession of the card throughout the period [EV-71797074]. The device fingerprint used in the transactions matches a device profile associated with a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-5f23e756]. Customer SC-03018 has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4319) on record, indicating potential recurring targeting [EV-77d5cdcc]. Pattern analysis retrieved six additional card-not-present fraud cases with similar characteristics, suggesting a broader campaign [EV-4526fa4d]. The verdict of fraud is supported by the convergence of anomalous transaction velocity, device reuse across fraud cases, customer dispute, and historical pattern alignment. Recommended actions include card replacement, enhanced monitoring for related device fingerprints, and referral to law enforcement given the organized nature indicated by prior cases.
